notes.title: Rev Up for a Win! Help Manic Mechanics Grab the 2024 ‘Better With Friends’ Steam
notes.content:
Hey, Mechanics Crew!

It’s time to gear up and hit the accelerator—Manic Mechanics is eligible for the 2024 Steam Awards, and we need your support to clinch the [b]‘Better With Friends’ award![/b] We know Manic Mechanics is all about chaotic, high-octane teamwork and wrenching around with your best buddies. What better way to show off our tireless teamwork than winning this award?

Starting November 27th, you can nominate Manic Mechanics for [b]‘Better With Friends’ award[/b] and help us drive this game to victory! Here’s how to get us there:

[b]Fire away at the nomination link above:[/b] This is a quick and easy way to make your vote count! Simply check the box, follow the prompts and you'll be done before you can say Banshee Bay!

OR you can....
[list]
[*] [b]Pull Up to the '2024 Steam Awards' section via the Steam homepage[/b] 
[*] [b]Drive-by to the Manic Mechanics store page and click the '2024 Steam Awards' link[/b] 
[/list]
Whatever way you choose, make sure you select the [b]‘Better With Friends’ award[/b] to help us celebrate the high-octane (but mostly chaotic) teamwork that Manic Mechanics is all about!

You can spread the word and fuel our momentum by sharing with friends and fellow Mechanics fans on social media and in our community hub. Every vote brings us closer to the winner's podium.

Manic Mechanics is all about the fun of cranking, welding, and overcoming wacky repair challenges with your crew. With your support, we can take home the trophy and celebrate our favourite friends-first experience!

Let’s grease those gears and make this win a reality!

Thanks for all the love,
The Manic Mechanics Team
